teaser: You turn the key before you check the mirror, already pulling out of the lot. Life path 1 and ESTP meet in you as a single motion instead of two: decide and act arrive together, almost indistinguishable. The 1 asks for self-reliance and a willingness to go first; ESTP built its instincts around spotting the opening before anyone else names it. What gets skipped, in this particular crossing, is the pause most people use to check whether the lead they're taking is the right one, or just the fastest one available.
excerpt: Early evening, the funeral reception thinning to the people who actually knew him, and you're the one refilling drinks nobody asked you to refill — moving because stillness with grief feels worse.
